instruction.text: Use Johnny’s coins to solve the problems.

atoms.a: How much money does Johnny have in total?
Johnny wants to buy a chocolate bar that costs 40p and a packet of sweets that costs 50p. Write out the sum to work out how much they will cost.
How much more money will Johnny need?

instruction.text: Use Maisy’s coins to solve the problems.

atoms.a: How much money does Maisy have in total?
Maisy buys a packet of crisps for 60p. Write out the sum to work out how much money she has left.
Then Maisy buys some sweets for 20p. Write out the sum to work out how much money she has left.
